symbols.name: ValidateCurrentCalBlock
symbols.comment: Current calibration at $7B00: [0]=0, [1]=1 (version), [2..3]=length, CRC16 stored in the last 2 bytes; returns 1 if valid.

symbols.name: MainLoop
symbols.comment: Application main (called from Startup): factory/model detection, init, block validation, then the 1/20/100 ms scheduler loop.

symbols.name: IsrMscanWakeup
symbols.comment: Vector $FFDA; clears WUPIF (CRFLG=$80) to wake the CPU from STOP in sleep mode.

symbols.name: IsrTimebase
symbols.comment: Vector $FFDC; acks TBIF (TBCR bit3 TACK), periodic STOP wakeup while sleeping.

symbols.name: InitTim1Tick1ms
symbols.comment: T1SC=$30 (stop+reset), T1MOD=$1F40, T1SC=$40 (TOIE, /1): 1 kHz overflow at an 8 MHz bus.

symbols.name: StopTim1
symbols.comment: T1SC=$30 before entering sleep.

symbols.name: RestartTim1TickDividers
symbols.comment: After wake: reset the 10/20/100 ms dividers (6/6/16) and restart TIM1 (T1SC=$40).

symbols.name: IsrTim1Overflow1msTick
symbols.comment: Vector $FFF2 (TIM1 overflow), 1 ms master tick: comms timers, CAN TX scheduling, 10/20/100 ms flags, ADC scan at phase 4 of 20 ms.

symbols.name: ValidateConfigBlock
symbols.comment: User config at $1E20: [0]=0, [1]=9 (format 9), [2..3]=length, CRC16 in the last 2 bytes; returns 0 if OK else error code (4 CRC, 3 header).

symbols.name: EnterErrorMode
symbols.comment: EnterErrorMode(code in X:A): all outputs off, store g_errorCode, g_runMode=1.

symbols.name: FilterBoardTemperature
symbols.comment: IIR filter (acc += raw - acc/16) on g_boardTempRaw; g_boardTemperature = tbl_BoardTempLookup[filtered].

symbols.name: ReadHardwareRevision
symbols.comment: g_hardwareRevision = boot_HardwareRevision ($FD80) if factory word $046A:$046B >= $00D2 and value <= 3, else 0.

symbols.name: CheckSleepCurrentMonitorEnabled
symbols.comment: g_sleepCurrentMonitorEnabled = any output config with flags (+12) bit0 set.

symbols.name: SelectAdcScanTable
symbols.comment: Picks the 90-entry ADC scan table for g_modelType and sets ADCLK=$70.

symbols.name: StartAdcScan
symbols.comment: StartAdcScan(A=0 full scan | A!=0 skip the first 3 entries): DDRB=$13 (mux address lines), first conversion discarded.

symbols.name: IsrAdcConversionComplete
symbols.comment: Vector $FFDE; stores ADRL per scan-table entry (current entries calibrated), then loads the next entry's PTB mux and ADSCR.

symbols.name: IsAdcScanRunning
symbols.comment: Returns DDRB!=0 (the scan drives the mux lines while active).

symbols.name: StartSingleAdcConversion
symbols.comment: Factory-test helper: sets PTB mux and ADSCR from a scan-table entry, continuous, no interrupt.

symbols.name: InitCanReceiveTimeouts
symbols.comment: g_canTimeoutFlags = cfg_CanRxTimeoutEnableMask, loads the 7 RX timeouts, sets MSCAN filters, marks CAN devices invalid.

symbols.name: TickCanReceiveTimeouts100ms
symbols.comment: 7 user CAN receive timeouts and 4 CAN-device timeouts, 100 ms tick -> g_canTimeoutFlags / g_canDevRxValidMask.

symbols.name: ParseUserCanReceiveFrame
symbols.comment: Matches non-comms frames against the 7 user RX definitions (cfg_CanRxDefs) and the 4 CAN devices; copies data to g_canRxData / g_canDevRxData.

symbols.name: InitCanTxBuffer0
symbols.comment: TXB0 DLC=8, priority 0.

symbols.name: BuildCanDeviceStateFrame
symbols.comment: TXB1 frame to a CAN device with 2 data bytes selected by a channel/mask.

symbols.name: BuildCanDeviceInitFrame
symbols.comment: TXB1, ID 0: data {1, cfg[dev]+1, 0...}; device address/initialisation broadcast.

symbols.name: BuildCanDeviceCompiledFrame
symbols.comment: TXB1 frame filled by a compiled config routine into g_compiledTxData; sent only on change or refresh.

symbols.name: ScheduleCanTransmit1ms
symbols.comment: From the 1 ms ISR: data-stream slot scheduling on TXB0 and user TX message timers.

symbols.name: SendDataStreamFrameTxb0
symbols.comment: MoTeC 'PDM Generic Output' CAN stream frame (IDs 0x500-0x505 by default) for g_dataStreamSlot 0..49.

symbols.name: SendUserCanFramesTxb1
symbols.comment: 10-state TXB1 sequence: the 4 user transmit messages and the CAN-device frames.

symbols.name: InitCanTxBuffer1Timers
symbols.comment: TXB1 DLC=8, priority 0; g_canDevTxFlags[0..3]=1; user TX timers=1.

symbols.name: KickCanTxBuffer1Sequence
symbols.comment: Every 20 ms: if the TXB1 sequence is idle, start it at index 1.

symbols.name: RunFactoryTestStateMachine
symbols.comment: Production end-of-line test (g_runMode 2) driven by g_testCommand and tbl_TestStepHandlers.

symbols.name: TestStep00Start
symbols.comment: Waits for test command $2222, clears outputs, starts the ADC scan, then step 1.

symbols.name: TestStep01CheckBatteryVoltage
symbols.comment: Pass if g_batteryVoltageRaw is in $3B..$40; else fail 2 (low) / 3 (high).

symbols.name: TestStep02CheckChannel3Load
symbols.comment: Checks the PTD0 line via scan entry 3 with output 2 on (>= 200 counts delta).

symbols.name: TestStep03
symbols.comment: Per-output test loop over g_numOutputs using the full ADC scan.

symbols.name: TestStep04
symbols.comment: Per-output on/off test with ADC (V/I sense) checks.

symbols.name: TestStep05CheckPta1Feedback
symbols.comment: Samples input 1 with PTA1 clear/set (skipped on PDM32 subtype 0).

symbols.name: TestStep09
symbols.comment: Single-channel ADC check gated by g_modelSubType.

symbols.name: TestStep06
symbols.comment: Per-input test loop over g_numInputs (full scan).

symbols.name: TestStep07
symbols.comment: Per-input test with outputs driven (input pull-up/down response).

symbols.name: TestStep08
symbols.comment: Input test using single conversions + delays (COP fed).

symbols.name: TestStep10Idle
symbols.comment: End of the test sequence; command $1111 restarts it.

symbols.name: InitLogicEnginePointers
symbols.comment: Zero-page ABI for compiled logic: $0040=&g_channelTable, $0044=&g_logicScratch, $0046=&g_logicDebounce.

symbols.name: EvaluateCompiledLogicChannels
symbols.comment: The PDM conditions/functions engine: calls compiled HC08 routines from $22BF for up to 200 logic channels with debounce.

symbols.name: InitOutputPorts
symbols.comment: Clears g_outputRuntime, drives all output pins low, sets port directions, stops TIM2, sets up the output-9 interlock pointer.

symbols.name: SumOutputCurrents
symbols.comment: g_totalCurrent = sum(I[0..7])/2 + sum(I[8..31])/5 (amps, saturating at $FF).

symbols.name: UpdateOutputThermalModel
symbols.comment: Every 100 ms per output: I^2t accumulator, level, and g_outputLoad lookup; level >= 256 is the overcurrent trip.

symbols.name: UpdateOutputStateMachines
symbols.comment: Every 20 ms: per-output state machine (OFF/ON/fault/retry/latched), status bytes, pin shadows, output-9 special handling.

symbols.name: IsrTim2Overflow
symbols.comment: Vector $FFEC; one-shot: stops TIM2, sets g_output9Pulse and PTA1.

symbols.name: CheckMonitoredOutputsDrawingCurrent
symbols.comment: While sleeping: returns 1 if any output with cfg+12 bit0 draws > 2 counts.

symbols.name: SetOutputPinDirect
symbols.comment: SetOutputPinDirect(A=on/off, X=output idx): sets the output's port bit directly (factory test only).

symbols.name: ClearAllOutputPins
symbols.comment: Zeroes the port shadows and PTA/PTC/PTD/PTE/PTF.

symbols.name: InitPllClock
symbols.comment: InitPllClock(A=0 full speed | !=0 half): reprogram the PLL (N=8 -> 8 MHz bus from 4 MHz crystal) after STOP.

symbols.name: DelayLoop16
symbols.comment: Busy-wait countdown on X:A (about 4 cycles per count).

symbols.name: DelayLoopWithCopFeed
symbols.comment: n x DelayLoop16($3E0), feeding the COP each pass (about 1 ms per n).

symbols.name: CalculateCrc16
symbols.comment: CalculateCrc16(ptr H:X, len16): table-driven CRC-16/CCITT (poly $1021) init $FFFF; feeds the COP.

symbols.name: InitMscan
symbols.comment: MSCAN init: CLKSRC=bus, CBTR1=$14, CBTR0 BRP by bitrate index (0 = 500 kbit/s @ 8 MHz), resets comms node IDs.

symbols.name: SetMscanFilterTable
symbols.comment: Stores a pointer to an 8-byte filter (from config) and calls ConfigureMscanAcceptanceFilters.

symbols.name: ConfigureMscanAcceptanceFilters
symbols.comment: Programs CIDAR/CIDMR for the comms ID block plus the user filter, CRIER=1 (RXFIE).

symbols.name: IsrMscanReceive
symbols.comment: Vector $FFD6; PDM Manager comms IDs (default $3F0-$3FF) handled here, everything else to ParseUserCanReceiveFrame.

symbols.name: ProcessCommsRequest
symbols.comment: Main-loop side of the PDM Manager CAN protocol: request types 9 connect, 10 erase, 13 write, 14 read; discovery beacon.

symbols.name: HandleCommsReadMemory
symbols.comment: Read {region, offset, len}: streams data frames on TXB2, 8 frames per block then waits for flow control.

symbols.name: SendCommsReadDataFrame
symbols.comment: Sends the next up-to-8-byte chunk of a comms read on TXB2.

symbols.name: SendCommsResponse
symbols.comment: SendCommsResponse(status, a, b, c, d): TXB2 frame ID (g_commsTxNode<<4)|$F, data {reqType, seq, status, ?, a, b, c, d}.

symbols.name: IsrMscanTransmit
symbols.comment: Vector $FFD4; disables TXE2 interrupt, continues read streaming or arms the 50 ms tx timeout.

symbols.name: HandleCommsConnect
symbols.comment: Connect request: if serial and CRC match, adopt new rx/tx node IDs, reprogram filters, ack.

symbols.name: SendCommsDiscoveryBeacon
symbols.comment: TXB2 29-bit discovery beacon {3, $11, serialIdHi, serialIdLo, rxNode, txNode, counter}.

symbols.name: HandleCommsWriteMemory
symbols.comment: Write {region, ?, offHi, offLo, ?, len, data...}: RAM or FLASH-2 via FlashProgramBytes, gated by CheckRegionAccessAllowed.

symbols.name: HandleCommsEraseFlash
symbols.comment: Erase {region, offset, length} in FLASH-2 ($1E20-$7FFF) via FlashErasePages.

symbols.name: SetDiscoveryBeaconEnabled
symbols.comment: g_beaconEnabled = (X:A != 0).

symbols.name: RequestDiscoveryBeacon
symbols.comment: g_beaconRequested=1.

symbols.name: TickCommsTimers1ms
symbols.comment: Decrements g_commsTxTimeout and the 16-bit g_beaconTimer.

symbols.name: ResetCommsStateUnused
symbols.comment: No callers found; resets the comms rx buffer pointer and state flags.

symbols.name: FlashProgramBytes
symbols.comment: FlashProgramBytes(dst, src, count16): FLASH-2 row programming via FL2CR; refuses $0980-$1B7F.

symbols.name: FlashErasePages
symbols.comment: FlashErasePages(start, len): 128-byte page erase loop via FL2CR; refuses $0980-$1B7F.

symbols.name: IsrUnusedDefault
symbols.comment: RTI; target of all unused vector-table entries.

symbols.name: DeriveUnlockKeysFromSerial
symbols.comment: g_derivedUnlockKeys = factory serial word ($0464:$0465) XOR $B1CC / $C1E5.

symbols.name: LoadFeatureUnlockState
symbols.comment: Picks the newer key bank ($0480 or $7A80), copies 11 bytes to $008E, compares with derived keys -> g_featureUnlockFlags.

symbols.name: StoreFeatureUnlockKeys
symbols.comment: Writes pending keys + $AAAA marker + sequence to the other key bank, erases the old one, reloads.

symbols.name: ProcessFeatureUnlockCommand
symbols.comment: g_unlockCmd: $11/$22 store key, $33/$44 verify key, $55 clear; result in g_unlockResult.

symbols.name: CheckRegionAccessAllowed
symbols.comment: Region 7 (except sub-op $0E) requires g_featureUnlockFlags bit1.

symbols.name: InitFeatureUnlock
symbols.comment: MoTeC option licensing init (keys derived from the factory serial, two flash key banks).

symbols.name: ParseSerialNumberDigits
symbols.comment: Parses the 5 ASCII digits at fact_SerialAscii ($047A) into a 16-bit serial number.

symbols.name: GetFactoryDataVersion
symbols.comment: Returns $0473 if the 'P' info block is present, else $FF.

symbols.name: Startup
symbols.comment: CodeWarrior HC08 C startup reached via app_EntryJump; SP=$0934, zero-init/copy-down, then MainLoop.

symbols.name: RtCopyToZeroPage
symbols.comment: Copies g_rtScratch bytes from H:X to the zero-page address on the stack.

symbols.name: RtMul16x16
symbols.comment: 16x16->16 multiply: (g_rtScratch:A) * (H:X); high byte in g_rtScratch.

symbols.name: RtSwitchJumpTable
symbols.comment: CodeWarrior switch helper: inline table of 16-bit addresses after the JSR, jumps to table[A].

symbols.name: RtSwitchSearchTable16
symbols.comment: CodeWarrior switch on a 16-bit value ($00F7:A) using a sorted {target,key} table at H:X.

symbols.name: RtLongCompare
symbols.comment: CodeWarrior 32-bit runtime (accumulator g_rtLongAcc $00F3..$00F6, operand at H:X): compare.

symbols.name: RtDivU16
symbols.comment: Unsigned 16-bit divide using the DIV instruction (H:A / X).
